`root` sets `font-size: 16px` with `line-height: 2`, so its computed `line-height` becomes `32px` (and that matches the rendered height for `root>small`). For `root>big`, it overrides `font-size` to `32px` and inherits `line-height: 2`, so the computed `line-height` becomes `32px * 2 = 64px`. The browser-reported `getBoundingClientRect()` for `root>big` also shows `height=64`.

ANSWER: 64
